label: AI-OPERATED SYNTHETIC MAP UPDATE; FRESH STATIC PLANNING FROM CURRENT POSITION

scenario.contributor: AI assistant (map/method/code); Junmo (guided pre-run remaining-length prediction)
scenario.assistance: AI supplied diagram, current-position distinction, layout and validation method. Student predicted four remaining moves only; no route, examined-node count, code authorship or independent execution inferred.
scenario.prediction: Student predicts minimum remaining route length 4 from current R to G after the new obstacle, before configured execution. No explicit route or search-work forecast supplied.
scenario.controls: One 5x2 grid update; only (3,0) changes from open to wall. S in parser rows is current R=(2,0), not original departure (0,0). Four-neighbor unit costs. Old remaining route is sliced at currentPathIndex. Fresh A* FIFO budget 30, separate from saved search state.
scenario.validation: Check old full route on original map, old remaining route on both maps, new path on changed map, and shortest remaining distance with independently implemented BFS. Preserve failed old-path validation separately from planner failure codes.
scenario.scope: Synthetic map-update validation followed by fresh static-map planning. Not an incremental replanner, automatic sensing, a moving-robot simulation or a physical measurement. No prior source result for this configured map was shown to the student.

oldRouteValidation.semantics: Path validation status, not BUDGET_EXCEEDED or UNREACHABLE; says nothing alone about alternative routes.

execution.attribution: Student supplied the quoted remaining-length prediction only. AI supplied map, method, source, execution and validation. No saved session was updated or reused.
